title: Kaun kaafir hai
body:
kaun kaafir hai kaun momin hai
waqt aane pe faisla hoga
baat khul jayegi qayamat mein
jab adalat ka saamna hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
zul asheera say hajj-e-aakhir tak
kis ko waaris kiya muhammad ne
kis ne tareekh ko badal daala
ye bhi taareekh mein likha hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mas'ala baagh ka nahi hargiz
mas'ala iddeaye haq ka hai
kis ki takzeeb kaun karta hai
bas isi pe mubahila hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
badshahat ko sabse pehli baar
kis ne pehnayi deen ki poshak
kab khilafat mulukiat mein dhali
kam se kam ab to sochna hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
khair to khair shar bhi acha hai
kaun samjhay ye falsafa kya hai
ek hi saath haq-o-baatil se
kaise raazi bhala khuda hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski takhleeq ka sabab giriya
jiske vird e zaban ali maula
usko nabood kar sakega kaun
jiski ta'eed mein khuda hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb par jinke mohr lag jaye
phir inhe saeyban naseeb kahan
ibne zehra ke rone walon par
hashr tak saaya-e-kisa hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
majlise gham hai fatema bhi hai
matame shaah-e-karbala hoga
ay azadaar ashke gham tera
nazre rumaal-e-sayyeda hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sina khaynchne chale honge
akbar-e-naujawan ke seene se
aastine ulat ke sarwar ne
kis tarha ya ali kaha hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf mashk-o-alam liye shabbir
aaye honge furaat se jis dam
binte shaah e zaman ke haathon se
khaali kuza bhi gir gaya hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil larazta hai aankh roti hai
thar'tari si badan mein hoti hai
shaah ka haal kya hua hoga
teer asghar ko jab laga hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya saans rok kar shahid
tak rahe hai hussain ki surat
garm reti pe zer-e-khanjar ab
sajdaye aakhri ada hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
author: Shahid Jafer
